_about: 0verse ground-truth eval corpus. Each item has KNOWN ground truth (label + bug location) and an explicit held-out flag (in_seed_set). The real-cve tier is faithful standalone extracts of upstream vulnerable functions WITH their fix commits (vulnerable + fixed builds); the sanity-floor tier is 0verse's own synthetic benchmark fixtures (in_seed_set=true, NOT held-out evidence). See docs/EVAL-GROUNDTRUTH.md and benchmarks/groundtruth/CATALOGUE-magma.json.

items.name: png_trns_vuln
items.label: vulnerable
items.provenance: libpng png_handle_tRNS() palette overflow; fixed in libpng 1.2.6 (clamp chunk length to num_palette). https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2004-0597
items.note: Faithful extract; read() models png_crc_read of the chunk. Plain memcpy bounded only by input length into a fixed buffer.

items.name: png_trns_fixed
items.label: clean
items.provenance: Post-fix libpng 1.2.6 png_handle_tRNS() with the length clamp. Any confirmed finding here is a false positive.
items.note: FP probe: the fixed build of the same source.

items.name: xml_content_vuln
items.label: vulnerable
items.provenance: libxml2 xmlSnprintfElementContent() buffer overflow; fixed in libxml2 commit e266305 (bound each strcat against remaining space). https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2017-9047
items.note: Faithful extract; read() models the tainted content->name.

items.name: xml_content_fixed
items.label: clean
items.provenance: Post-fix xmlSnprintfElementContent() with the remaining-space bound. Any confirmed finding here is a false positive.
items.note: FP probe: the fixed build of the same source.

items.name: sudo_fmt_vuln
items.label: vulnerable
items.provenance: sudo sudo_debug() format-string bug; fixed in sudo 1.8.3p2 (use a literal "%s"). https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2012-0809
items.note: Faithful extract; sink is printf (sudo used fprintf; the lens keys on the printf family).

items.name: sudo_fmt_fixed
items.label: clean
items.provenance: Post-fix sudo_debug() with the "%s" format. Any confirmed finding here is a false positive.
items.note: FP probe: the fixed build of the same source.
